question: Does either complete exact-equality fight-quality trigger have enough reproducible active, inactive, viable and two-package-separated Duskblade support to justify freezing at most one trigger for identity preflight?
competingOptions: freeze the first complete pass in the preregistered source-state simplicity order
close the complete exact-equality fight-quality family and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

scientificBasis.finiteSourceGrammar: The immutable fight summary has exactly two unclosed nonnegative quality counters with natural equality boundaries: hpLost equals zero and turns equals one on a won fight. Shatters, Smolder kills, fight kind, elite victory and all card-play grammars already have immutable decisions or aspect boundaries.
scientificBasis.selectionBeforeCounts: Both predicates and their order were derived from exact source state before any cohort aggregate was read. They are evaluated together once. No boss, elite, normal, card, threshold, conjunction or policy subset is available after the first look.
scientificBasis.differentStructuralAxis: A completed fight-quality invariant is an outcome-gated combat transition, not a scalar payoff, named-card order, acquisition carrier, permanent removal, elite-route transition, death chain or turn-state Energy hook.
scientificBasis.cheapestDiscriminatingEvidence: Reuse the 256 explicit-current fight summaries already proved exactly identical to the 256 frozen current-main baseline rows after trace labels are removed. No simulator or ledger row is required.
scientificBasis.claimBoundary: This is a necessary observational capacity inventory. It cannot identify a causal payoff, content carrier, policy effect, package interaction, product candidate or held-out result. A pass authorises identity preflight only.

candidates.mediator: A fight whose exact result is win and accumulated hpLost is exactly zero.
candidates.prospectiveTrigger: One observation-only Duskblade trigger after each existing qualifying fight.
candidates.stateJustification: Zero is the identity element of the existing nonnegative accumulated HP-loss counter; no magnitude threshold is introduced.

candidates.mediator: A fight whose exact result is win and completed turn count is exactly one.
candidates.prospectiveTrigger: One observation-only Duskblade trigger after each existing qualifying fight.
candidates.stateJustification: One is the minimum completed-turn count of the existing fight lifecycle; no duration threshold is introduced.

selectionJustification: The nonnegative HP-loss counter has the simpler algebraic identity boundary zero. The turn counter then has the minimum lifecycle boundary one. The first complete pass is frozen without outcome ranking; later passes receive no authority.
closedVariants: boss-only, elite-only, normal-only or named-encounter subsetting
HP-loss thresholds above zero or turn thresholds above one
conjunctions or disjunctions between the two predicates
card, relic, status, policy-coordinate or package-conditioned subsetting
changing persistence, trigger count, payoff, carrier, cohort or robustness rule after the first look

designMatrix.kind: two separate necessary-capacity mechanism blocks over one immutable observational cell; not a factorial
designMatrix.aliasStructure: A qualifying fight is downstream of map, enemy, cards, policy and combat strength. At-least-one whole-run activation does not identify which input caused the invariant or whether a future payoff would improve the run. The two candidate blocks can overlap and are not independent trials.
designMatrix.expansionRule: At most the first passing block may add identity-safe telemetry. No kind-specific, threshold, conjunction or joint-payoff cell is authorised. A later mechanism-blocked CRN must hold policies, seeds, baseline, first-look budget, estimator and stopping rule equal and add package-interference cells only for measured decision value.

capacityDefinitions.opportunityRow: At least one fight in the row has exact result win.
capacityDefinitions.activeRowNoHpLoss: At least one won fight has hpLost exactly zero.
capacityDefinitions.activeRowOneTurn: At least one won fight has turns exactly one.
capacityDefinitions.robustOpportunityPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are opportunity rows.
capacityDefinitions.robustActivePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are active for the candidate.
capacityDefinitions.exactInactivePolicy: None of four frozen rows is active for the candidate.
capacityDefinitions.ambiguousPolicy: Exactly one of four frozen rows is active for the candidate.
capacityDefinitions.viableRobustActivePolicy: A robust-active policy has at least one active row whose whole-run outcome is win.
capacityDefinitions.scorelineRoutePolicy: At least two of four rows play Chisel before a later Faultline in the same fight.
capacityDefinitions.afterimageRoutePolicy: At least two of four rows record positive afterimageGuardDamage.
capacityDefinitions.candidateOnlyPolicy: Robust-active for the candidate but not active for the named package anchor.
capacityDefinitions.anchorOnlyPolicy: Active for the named package anchor but not robust-active for the candidate.

mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: selected fight-quality trigger x future fight-quality payoff, because the payoff can occur only after its qualifying victory
fight quality x package use, because Scoreline or Afterimage may themselves contribute to a qualifying fight
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.scorelineInterference: Scoreline payoff remains fixed and separate. Exact overlap is a shared-anchor capacity screen, not an interaction estimate.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.afterimageInterference: Afterimage payoff remains fixed and separate. Exact overlap is a shared-anchor capacity screen, not an interaction estimate.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.candidateOverlap: The same fight may satisfy both exact predicates. Results are reported separately; neither supplies evidence for the other and at most the first complete pass can be selected.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.staging: Cached fight evidence may advance at most one trigger to identity-safe telemetry. No payoff or whole-run endpoint can be claimed until every causal contrast evaluates it on one frozen equal cohort.

identityPreflightIfAuthorised.null: Omitted and explicit level 0 must reproduce exact policy, map, combat, rewards, RNG, state and result on all 256 identities.
identityPreflightIfAuthorised.enabled: The selected level 1 may append exactly one observation after each qualifying Duskblade victory and must change no queue ordering, reward, policy, state or RNG. Ashwarden and nonqualifying wins are negative controls.

estimator.stopping: Freeze at most the first complete pass in source-state simplicity order; close the family when neither passes; otherwise record inconclusive only at the numeric cap.

gates.provenance: The 16 opportunity/active/inactive and eight viability/two-sided-separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy scale. Both packages retain the frozen 0.75 Jaccard ceiling, and one fault is the immutable cached baseline. No threshold depends on fight-quality counts.

decisionRules.success: The first candidate in frozen order whose opportunity, active, inactive, viability, separate Scoreline/Afterimage separation, source/cache identity, fight-schema integrity and reliability gates all pass is selected; later passes receive no authority.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze exactly the selected trigger for source-placement and identity preflight. Implement no payoff or content. Prove omitted/level-0 exact policy, map, combat, reward, RNG, state and result identity across all 256 rows, then prove on focused controls that level 1 emits only after the exact qualifying Duskblade victory and changes no simulation state. A later preregistration is required before any payoff or simulator row.
decisionRules.futility: Neither candidate passes every frozen gate.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the complete exact-equality fight-quality trigger family. Continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421; do not add a fight-kind subset, threshold, conjunction, payoff, carrier, policy filter or rerun.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Current-main source, immutable cache or deterministic decision cannot complete before the wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without implementation, simulator spend, trace extension, payoff, carrier, ML/RL or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns source validation, cache identity, the complete two-member grammar, classification, frozen-order selection, both package comparisons and stop/go. Issue #524 and #525 are immutable scientific evidence only and are not reconstructed. No model context, human label, optimiser, ML, RL or adaptive candidate iteration enters execution.
